title: AssetRecord
description: Output of the Asset Manager: tracks every version of a generated or uploaded asset (video, preview image, metadata blob) for a project/shot. Does not own the bytes themselves - `versions[].uri` points to wherever the asset actually lives (a compute provider's output URI, local dev storage, or eventually S3/R2), per packages/storage-sdk.

shot_id.description: Set when this asset belongs to a single shot (e.g. a generated video clip); omitted for project-level assets.
